# GitHub Copilot instruction files

This folder is reserved for GitHub Copilot instruction files (`*.instructions.md`). These files provide topic-specific conventions that GitHub Copilot follows when working in this repository - such as writing style, coding patterns, terminology, and formatting rules.

Instruction files are excluded from version control via `.gitignore` because their content is considered highly individual - they reflect personal workflows, preferences, and conventions that vary from person to person and from organization to organization. Adding instruction files to this folder is entirely optional and should be done by the individual user or organization.

For an introduction to GitHub Copilot instruction files and how to get started, see [dotjesper/hello-world](https://github.com/dotjesper/hello-world "This repository contains the source code for the Hello World demonstration project").
